It quoted: "We, Lakeside Scientific Supplies Ltd., accept that we will be suspended from being eligible for bidding in any contract with the procuring and disposing entity for three years if we withdraw our bid during the period of bid validity, or if we fail to sign the contract after being notified of acce..." The quotation was confirmed to appear in the submission. The evidence check then compared the quotation with the requirement, without the rest of the submission. It described the quoted passage as "Bidder's Undertaking" and the requirement as "Bid Securing Declaration". It judged them to be different documents and rejected the quotation. The item was therefore reported Not Found.
